name: Minimum Maximum-Parent Rank
definition: For a nonempty proper maximum-generated class $C$, $h(C)=\min\{r:(r,s)\in\mathcal F(C)\text{ for some }s\}$ is the least rank of a maximum class having $C$ as a coordinate section.
normalization: The visible positioned coordinate set is retained; auxiliary coordinates alone may be added.
comments: Always at least the VC dimension. Constant visible coordinates can affect related auxiliary costs even when the one-inclusion graph is unchanged.
